question.worked_solution:
If $X$ follows a discrete uniform distribution over a set $S,$ then $X$ has the following probability mass function:

$$
f(x)=\{\begin{aligned}\frac{1}{|S|}, & x\in S \\ 0, & \text{otherwise}\end{aligned}
$$

Here, we have $X∼U\{1,3,5,6,8,10,12\},$ and the set $S=\{1,3,5,6,8,10,12\}$ has $|S|=7$ items. So, we have

$$
f(x)=\{\begin{aligned}\frac{1}{7}, & x=1,3,5,6,8,10,12 \\ 0, & \text{otherwise}.\end{aligned}
$$

In $S,$ there are $2$ items $(5,6)$ that satisfies $3<X<8.$ Therefore,

$$
P(3<X<8)=2\cdot \frac{1}{7}=\frac{2}{7}.
$$
